overview_description: Delete an email from an account's email history.
intro: An account keeps a history of the emails sent to or from it. This area deletes one email from that history; listing and reading emails are in Accounts. It has 1 endpoint, and every SDK supports it.
notes: **Identify the email by its `uuid`.** [List an account's emails](/api-reference/accounts/list-an-accounts-emails) returns each email's `uuid`.
**Identify the account by its `id`.** The `id` is a short code such as `W13ZGY`, not the account's `uuid`.
**A successful delete returns `200`.** [Retrieve an email](/api-reference/accounts/retrieve-an-email) then returns `404` for that `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Delete an account email
endpoints.summary: Deletes one email from an account's email history.
endpoints.description: Pass the account's `id` and the email's `uuid`, as List an account's emails returns it. Returns `200`. Retrieving the email afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account's `id`, such as `W13ZGY`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: email_uuid
parameters.description: The email's `uuid`, as returned by List an account's emails.
